someone who loves translating human problems into math (though I'm still learning the ropes).

I have an interdisciplinary background, and a love-hate relationship with AI. I try to train my mind to understand hard things, even when I don't understand them yet. I may not be the cream of the crop, but I am what's left when the rest of the cream goes away. In other words, I'm tenacious.

Most of my professional work is proprietary. The projects in the sidebar are ones I can share, with code (where applicable). Below is a brief timeline of my education and work experience.
